title: h-Adaptive FV Subcell Shock-Capturing for DGSEM on Heterogeneous Curvilinear Meshes
summary: High-order methods offer superior dispersion and dissipation properties compared to low-order schemes but require robust stabilization for discontinuities. To ensure stability, local artificial viscosity is common, but often degrades sub-element resolution. Conversely, subcell resolution preserving limiting strategies such as the finite volume subcell method are typically restricted to uniform topologies, such as purely hexahedral or simplex meshes, or linear elements.
